name: @opencues/dsh
description: OpenCues for DeepSeek Harness — LLM word alternatives and `_`-gated blank fill-ins in the dsh composer.
//publishConfig: Both fields are load-bearing and neither is a default we can rely on.
access: a SCOPED package publishes RESTRICTED unless told otherwise, so
omitting this would put @opencues/dsh on npm as a private package and
`dsh plugin add @opencues/dsh` would 404 for everyone — the one install
registry: every sibling @opencues/* integration points publishConfig at
npm.pkg.github.com, and an ambient .npmrc can set one too. Stating the
public registry here means this package cannot be silently published to
the wrong one by inherited config.
